args.prompt: Game character turnaround reference. The vagrant stands perfectly still in a neutral idle pose on an invisible turntable and rotates a full 360 degrees at a constant speed, turning to show his left side, then his back, then his right side, then front again. Locked-off camera, slightly elevated looking down, no camera movement, no zoom, no perspective change. Plain flat white background, even soft lighting. The design stays exactly identical: a travel-worn vagrant with a short brown beard, a patched grey-brown hooded cloak the colour of weathered timber, a faded cream tunic, a frayed rope belt, scuffed brown boots, empty hands, no weapon. No flashing, glowing or pulsing light: every colour keeps exactly the same brightness in every frame. Crisp sharp detail in every frame, no motion blur, no ghosting, no walking, no text.

Game sprite walk cycle. The vagrant walks in place on a treadmill, keeping exactly the facing direction of the first frame (facing the camera). Holding exactly the body angle of the first frame: torso does not twist. Tired steady walk: legs alternating clearly, slight body bob, cloak swaying a little. The vagrant stays exactly centered, does not turn, move or change size. Locked-off camera, no zoom, plain flat white background, even lighting, crisp frames, no motion blur. Two full steps, loops seamlessly back to the starting pose.
